command.powershell:
cd $HOME
$ptr = (Select-String -Path "$HOME\.claude\CLAUDE.md" -Pattern '^@(.+)/CLAUDE\.md\s*$' | Select-Object -First 1).Matches[0].Groups[1].Value
$cs = (Resolve-Path ($ptr -replace '^~', $HOME)).Path
cd $cs
git fetch origin main
$wt = Join-Path $env:TEMP "cs-windows-local-lint"
git worktree add --detach $wt origin/main
cd $wt
$t0 = Get-Date
.\bin\verdict .\bin\ci-job checks --lint
"exit=$LASTEXITCODE start=$t0 end=$(Get-Date)"
cd $cs
git worktree remove --force $wt

context:
Goal: the lint checks run the same on your Windows laptop as in CI.
Why you: the proof needs a real Windows machine; every Claude session here runs Linux.
Steps: open PowerShell on the Windows laptop and paste the command below. It makes a throwaway copy of claude-settings main, runs the lint checks, prints one line starting with exit=, and removes the copy. Paste that last line into the note here, then press Done.
short: Run the lint check once on Windows
title: Run the new local lint check once on your Windows laptop and paste the last line
why: #1297 (merged 18:49 CST) makes the lint checks run on Windows. Only a Windows machine can prove it, and no cloud session runs Windows.
